$comment: WireAdapter contract (context pipeline §3.3, §4.1, §9.4). Every adapter takes the same ContextPlan and must produce the request-body subset below (deep JSON equality on these keys only; other request fields are out of scope). Attachments keep each provider's existing part builders and are not covered here.

families.openai_chat: OpenAI Chat Completions and compatible providers that accept content parts
families.openai_chat_string_only: OpenAI-compatible providers whose recipe marks content as string-only
families.llamacpp: local llama.cpp native engine (string content only)
families.managed: hosted managed chat channel (string or text parts)
families.openai_responses: OpenAI Responses API and Responses-compatible providers

rules: system: chat-shaped families → first message role=system; Responses → instructions; Anthropic → top-level system string; Gemini → systemInstruction.parts[0].text. Omitted when plan.system is null. Never more than one system carrier.

Block-capable families keep blocks: a message with one text block is a string (chat / managed / Responses) or a one-element array (Anthropic content, Gemini parts); more blocks → text parts (Responses uses input_text for user and output_text for assistant). String-only families join blocks with \n\n.
Anthropic: exactly one cache_control {type: ephemeral}, on the last non-dynamic block of the last user message; no top-level cache_control.

Stateful continuation (Responses previous_response_id) only when instructionsMode is resend or omit AND system, model and checkpoint are unchanged since the referenced leg; resend sends instructions, omit does not; otherwise send the full plan.

Tool-call arguments: chat-shaped families and Responses pass the arguments string through unchanged; Anthropic tool_use.input and Gemini functionCall.args decode it to an object — empty or all-whitespace → {}; invalid JSON or a non-object value is an error.
